summary: Frontend-only testing of the Carlos Sibaja portfolio (dark-mode, single-page). Ran full Playwright coverage at desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All 9 requested feature areas pass. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectModal outer container has class 'overflow-hidden' on the fixed wrapper AND the inner panel is the actual scroll container (overflow-y-auto). This is correct and working — inner is scrollable (verified scrollHeight 1655 > clientHeight 948).

Modal scrim closes via onClick handler as expected. Note: with the default centered-click strategy of Playwright, tests must click at a position that lies outside the modal panel; this is a test-technique detail, not an app bug.
PROFILE.linkedin currently points to https://www.linkedin.com/ (root) — should be Carlos's actual LinkedIn URL when available; not blocking.
PROFILE.location string in data ('San Diego, CA — Relocating to Miami, FL · Dec 2026') is duplicated in Contact.jsx as two separate hard-coded lines. Consider single source of truth. Not blocking.
Timeline has exactly 6 items with data-testid='timeline-item-0' through 'timeline-item-5' matching spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portfolio is a static single-page React site (framer-motion for animation). All data-testid attributes are in place per spec: navbar (nav-home/projects/journey/contact + nav-mobile-toggle + nav-mobile-{id}), hero-view-work-btn/hero-contact-btn, project-card-{id} (4 ids), project-modal, modal-scrim, modal-close-btn, timeline-item-0..5, resume-download-btn (triggers sonner toast 'Resume coming soon'), contact-email (mailto:Carlossibaja18@gmail.com), contact-linkedin (target=_blank rel=noopener). NOTE: When running Playwright, avoid wait_for_load_state('networkidle') — the site keeps some background image / animation traffic active and can time out. Use wait_for_selector('[data-testid=navbar]') + small timeout instead. Also: to test modal-scrim close, click at a coordinate OUTSIDE the modal panel (e.g. position={x:20,y:20} or mouse.click(panel.left - 50, viewportH/2)) because scrim's center is behind the modal content.
